_comment: The BASE config, and the only one that ships to production. appsettings.Development.json and appsettings.Production.json are both gitignored - Aspire4Wasm's AppHost writes them with localhost ports when you run the AppHost - so a published bundle has this file and nothing else, which is what makes the address below the production one. Same arrangement as GSBC.ImpactKids.WASM.

Services._comment: Resolves the https://yarp service-discovery name every gRPC client is registered against - see Extensions/GrpcServiceExtensions.cs. Without it the browser fetches a host literally called `yarp`, DNS fails, and every call dies as `TypeError: Failed to fetch`, surfacing on the form as `Could not reach the server`. Same origin as the app on purpose: this is the proxy that served the page, which is what lets the __gsbc_anon draft cookie ride along.
